title: simulationSettings renamed and restructured as decided in RG12.31, with every change the deprecation needs
author: Claude-JG
description: No substructure ends in Settings (solution, linearSolver), solution.file/.sensors/.restart, show.*, timeIntegration.realtime and .solverType, newton.active/.residualMode, camel case fixes; the old names forward until 2031; C++, library, scripts (exudev scripts --fix), documentation and tests follow (maintainer 2026-10-03).
releaseNotes: the simulation settings are reordered - solution.file, solution.sensors, solution.restart, linearSolver, show, timeIntegration.solverType, explicit and realtime, newton.active and residualMode; every old name still works with a warning until 2031, and exudev scripts --fix rewrites a script to the new names
